about: Hold-out 2 for the Q-123 n8n AI support bot, written and sealed by a separate session that never builds the bot (tests/CASES.md section 8b, eval config v4). Inputs: tests/CASES.md, tests/kb/, tests/grading.py, tests/cases/visible.json, tests/make_cases.py and the 2026-10-18 Upwork n8n demand research file; no other repository file, no n8n, no API calls. Checks run on the whole set (exit 0): no duplicate IDs, no clash with visible.json, every ID starts with HN- and matches its kind; keys only from the visible.json format; every expected route exists and fits its kind; every must_include fact is in the case's source articles and no must_not fact is; no canary is in the public KB or in a customer turn; for every R and F case a hand-written good reply passes grading.grade_reply and a bad reply fails, and every critical case's bad reply raises its own critical failure, with the conversation_canaries of all readable cases passed as extra_canaries; no customer turn is close to a visible turn; counts per kind meet the minimums. This file holds no case content.
author: separate session, never builds
how_to_open: At the first gated run of the series only: take holdout2.zip from the folder q123-holdout-2 in the owner's user profile. Check that its SHA-256 equals archive_sha256; if it does not, the hold-out 2 result is void. Unzip only the zip into a new empty folder outside the repo and follow README.txt inside. The runner stops if any case ID is in two sets.
